tasks.desc: Ideate the structural reduction to top-half minus bottom-half scores and candidate data structures.

Implement the complete Python solution using a two-heap MedianSplit class for the even-segment score, handle even N directly, and for odd N compute prefix/suffix scores for all even 0-indexed leftover positions, then verify it against the provided sample tests without hardcoding them.

proposals: Implement the noncrossing-matching sign reduction with two heaps for prefix and suffix half-sums, paying close attention to parity and rebalancing.
Use a persistent segment tree or wavelet tree as an alternative range top-k sum method if heap maintenance becomes error-prone.
Develop an offline Fenwick/parallel-binary-search approach for prefix top-k sums as a fallback data-structure strategy.
Explore interval DP or general noncrossing matching formulations only to confirm that they are too slow or lack the needed optimization.
Build small brute-force validators and test greedy adjacent removal to identify counterexamples and verify the structural formula.
